Ford Motor Company. Ford takes exception to NHTSA's comments on reducing the margin of safety in meeting emission standards and making adjustments or calibrations that adversely affect the deterioration rate of the emission control system. Ford stated that they will not make either of these compromises in the design of their vehicles. Ford stated that they must assure certification on emission standards and have acceptable confidence of meeting SEA and California end-of-line testing requirements which would be jeopardized if design safety margins were reduced. Further they stated that there is no reason to expect that the life of emission system components would be changed due to any fuel economy improvements planned by Ford for 1979.
